newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-HOIUPANK SAYS MAY LIFT 1997 PROFIT FORECAST.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-HOIUPANK SAYS MAY LIFT 1997 PROFIT FORECAST.

text.p: Estonia's Hoiupank said on Wednesday it may lift its 1997 profit forecasts that currently stand at 130 million kroons for the bank and 140 million kroons for the group.
"It is probable that we may adjust the profit forecast upwards," Hoiupank's chairman Olari Taal told Reuters in an interview.
In 1996 the bank reported an unaudited net profit of 67 million kroons for the bank. The group's figure has not yet been released.
"We will be able to double last year's profit this year and also for the next two years -- double the previous year's profits," Taal said.
Taal said the increase in private savings in Estonia was a major factor behind the bank's growth.
"Hoiupank has the largest market share in terms of individuals' deposits," he said.
Hoiupank is Estonia's second largest bank but will rank third after an ongoing merger between Union Bank and North-Estonian Bank is completed.
